stage.name: Villaviciosa to Gijón
stage.narrative: Gijón is the largest city in Asturias — a Roman port that became an industrial port that became a post-industrial beach town. Playa de San Lorenzo is 1.5 km of beach in the middle of the city, with the old town (Cimadevilla) on a rocky headland at one end. The Universidad Laboral is worth seeing on the outskirts — a Franco-era monument that is both beautiful and uncomfortable history. Like Bilbao, Gijón is a rest-day candidate.
stage.closing: Roman port, Franco monument, post-industrial beach. What is the right way to walk through layered history in a single afternoon?
